fields.name: Eng. Tenywa Ibrahim
fields.title: Mining Engineer
fields.bio:
Eng. Tenywa Ibrahim is a Mining Engineer with over three years of hands-on experience in underground, surface, and artisanal mining operations. He currently serves as a Mining Engineer at LACLARZ Investments Ltd, leading iron ore mining operations, mine planning, production optimization, geological mapping, ore body evaluation, and mineral resource assessment.

He holds professional certifications in Mine Design & Planning and Primavera P6 Project Planning and is currently pursuing a Master's degree in Environment and Natural Resources at Kabale University.

Eng. Ibrahim is passionate about applying modern geological mapping technologies and spatial data analysis to improve mineral exploration, mine planning, and sustainable resource development.
